Bring spacious, safe, and rejuvenating heat into your home with the Dynamic Bergamo Edition—a 4-person infrared sauna built from reforested Canadian hemlock. Its elegantly compact footprint helps carry deep, even FAR infrared warmth using Low EMF carbon heating panels while preserving floor space.

Designed for wellness and ambiance, Bergamo features interior chromotherapy color lighting with red‑light therapy and subtle exterior accent lighting. Its tempered bronze glass door and sleek exterior frame deliver a premium, modern aesthetic, while Bluetooth‑capable audio and MP3/aux support help you personalize each session.

Easy to install, the sauna snaps together tool‑free and operates on a single 120 V/20 A circuit. With interior and exterior LED control panels, you can monitor and customize heat, lighting, and session settings smoothly. It heats up efficiently, reaching up to 140 °F
